annotations.title: Institutional crypto portfolio Value at Risk (95%/99% VaR), CVaR, Sh

description: [0.010000 USDC via x402] Computes coherent empirical daily 95% and 99% Value at Risk (VaR), 95% Expected Shortfall (CVaR), simple and log daily returns, annualized volatility, max drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, Probabilistic Sharpe confidence, and minimum-variance BTC short hedge USD notional from UTC-midnight-aligned DefiLlama daily price history.

assets.description: Portfolio weights (shorthand tickers BTC/ETH/SOL/LINK/UNI/AAVE/ARB/OP or 'coingecko:...' IDs).

lookback_days.description: Historical daily lookback window in UTC days between 14 and 90 (default 60).

portfolio_value_usd.description: Total portfolio notional in USD for dollar VaR/CVaR and hedge sizing (default '100000').
